threepl.funcs

Class HasFieldFunc

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.funcs.InbuiltFunc
      • threepl.funcs.HasFieldFunc
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Constant

    public class HasFieldFunc
extends InbuiltFunc
implements Constant
    An inbuilt function to determine if a type is a struct containing a designated field. This has 2 arguments, the first being a variable and the second a field identifier. If the first variable is a type variable that type will be examined, otherwise the type of the variable will be examined, i.e. you can pass a struct type or a variable of struct type. The value returned is type log.
